name: The Heartwood door
description: A ward arch at the hem of the grove the old folk keep and do not explain. It is not sealed with masonry; it is sealed with permission, which is harder work to break. The Evenguard here are courteous the way a drawn bow is courteous.

signs.title: THE HEARTWOOD
lines: the wood past this arch is not walked
it is not a rule, it is a fact
